existingDiagnosticCallers.gen01Attribution: passed; existing fixture with two identical schemas, one route, zero effects; source fragments and full byte attribution reconciled

attempts.reason: First invocation refused uncommitted source before executing a fixture; successful retry used a clean production tree.
Schema-cost diagnostic expected a private function in the original monolith. Two callers updated to use the extracted owner; complete unit/JavaScript retry passed.

performance.interpretation: Two serial before/after PS-08 pairs; both existing comparator checks passed. Six artifact hashes are identical in all runs. Schema RSS prompted the repeat; the second pair reversed the median change. Descriptive observations, no statistical significance or performance gate.
performance.layout: Shared fields and ordered fixture identities are factored out of each original PS-08 report. Reconstruct a report with shared fields, run fields excluding id/cells, and cells formed by merging each ordered fixture identity with that run cell. No observations discarded.

dependencies.workspacePreparation: lockfile install with scripts disabled; pnpm build required before run

cache.warm: same process after warmup; fresh request lifecycle

timing.buildMs: CLI imports, project resolution and buildProject; excludes fixture setup and worker startup
timing.coldLoadMs: artifact reads and runtime imports; JavaScript application/codecs import; Native instantiation occurs in requests
timing.firstRequestMs: first complete provider-host request including request construction/body materialization, Native validation/compilation/instantiation and mandatory request disposal
timing.warmRequestMs: same complete request after warmup, including request construction, body materialization and mandatory disposal; correctness assertions outside timer
timing.cleanupMs: delete per-cell project and build outputs after all samples; excluded from build/load/request
timing.compilerPeakRssBytes: maximum individual ASC process resourceUsage.maxRSS, including its source-map re-exec; never summed; Native only; JavaScript compiler/build worker high-water RSS (includes imports/writer)
timing.artifactBytes: Native executable Wasm; JavaScript emitted executable .js/.cjs modules and schema codecs; dependencies/inspection excluded
